item.title: Allen Keller: Merry Christmas ... from the eighth century
item.description: On Christmas Day 800 A.D., a very interesting event took place – and one of great importance to Western history. On this day, Pope Leo III crowned the Frankish King Charlemagne Imperator Romanorum, or Emperor of Rome. item.title: State examiners give clean audit to Alabama Department of Veterans Affairs under fired commissioner Kent Davis
item.description: The Alabama Department of Examiners of Public Accounts released an audit last week of the Alabama Department of Veterans Affairs (ADVA) that found no "significant instances of noncompliance" during the tenure of fired commissioner Kent Davis.
